subject: Your call about a family reunion booking
body:
Hi Grace,

Thanks for calling about your family reunion, 2 to 5 October. A booking for seven guests is something our team likes to arrange personally, to make sure everyone is comfortably placed - one of us will call you back shortly to sort out the details with you.
ai_suggested_reply: Hi Grace, we would be glad to host your family reunion. A Classic Room sleeps two, so for seven guests we would recommend a mix of rooms - happy to put a plan together for 2 to 5 October, just let us know a good time to call.
